title: Owned-server drain diagnostics and docs: readdir errors, deadline message, missing-NStgid reason, Linux fail-closed cases
outcome: (1) children_of silently skips a /proc readdir entry error, so a partly failed scan can count as clean; count it as unclean or record it. (2) 'the drain ran out of time with children left' is reported even when a round finished with nothing pending at the deadline; report it only for a cut-short or still-pending round. (3) On kernels without NStgid the failure says '/proc is not in this process's PID namespace'; name the real cause. (4) agent-delegation-sessions.md says every descendant ends on Linux, without the fail-closed cases that shared-codex-app-server.md documents (namespace mismatch or missing NStgid, kernels before 5.3, seccomp blocking pidfd_open, unreadable records).
acceptance: A readdir error marks the scan unclean; the deadline message appears only when children were left; the missing-NStgid case reports its real cause; agent-delegation-sessions.md states the Linux fail-closed cases or links them.
